description:
Validate a claim before submission: estimate denial risk and show coverage status, prior-auth need, documentation requirements and the policies behind them.
Use it when a user asks whether a claim for given procedure and diagnosis codes is likely to be denied, or what documentation the payer will expect. To test one policy's structured criteria as well, pass policy_id with coverage_parameters.
Limits: answers come only from the policies Backwork indexes (Medicare NCDs, LCDs and Articles, and the commercial payer policies in its catalog). It does not submit or look up a real claim and has no claim history; when no policy matches it reports the result as unknown. Up to 10 procedure codes.
Side effects: none. It is read-only.

Takes codes, payers, plan types and states only. Never send patient names, dates of birth, member IDs or other patient identifiers.

Supports optional response_format: 'markdown' (default) for readable text or 'json' for the returned structuredContent object.

coverage_parameters.description: Policy criteria inputs when policy_id is supplied

date_of_service.description: Policy as-of date, YYYY-MM-DD: the date whose policy version applies.

idempotency_key.description: Optional key that makes the API return the cached result of an earlier identical call

payer.description: Payer name, slug or code, e.g. 'Aetna'. Omit for traditional Medicare.

policy_id.description: Optional policy ID to evaluate against structured parameters

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for readable text or 'json' for machine-readable structuredContent.

state.description: Two-letter state used to infer the Medicare jurisdiction, e.g. TX

name: backwork_claim_validation

data.description: Structured data returned by the Backwork API when available.

message.description: Human-readable result, status, or empty-result message.

meta.description: Response metadata such as pagination when available.

provenance.description: Where the answer came from and how current it is. Cite source_urls when answering.

as_of.description: Latest effective date among the cited sources.

authorities.description: Issuing authorities, for example "CMS" or a payer name.

retrieved_at.description: Oldest retrieval time among the cited sources: every source was fetched at or after this time.

source_urls.description: Distinct source document URLs to cite.

title: Claim Validation
